end.summary: Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
end.parentNote: Asha practised soil animals through questions and examples about tunnels and dead leaves. Pihu identified that tunnels bring air and water to soil, but continued to say that earthworms harm soil and eat crop roots; this mix-up was not corrected by the end. At home, look at a plant or garden bed and talk about how earthworm tunnels can help air and water move through soil.
